# Amazon India Sales & Business Performance Dashboard

## Project Overview

This project focuses on analyzing Amazon India sales data and developing an interactive Power BI dashboard to monitor business performance.

The dashboard provides insights into sales, profitability, product performance, order status, payment methods, fulfillment channels, and geographic performance.

The objective is to help business stakeholders understand key performance indicators and make data-driven decisions.

## Business Objectives

- Analyze overall sales and profit performance.
- Identify top-performing product categories and products.
- Evaluate delivered, returned, and cancelled orders.
- Analyze payment and fulfillment methods.
- Understand state-wise sales and profitability.

## Tools & Technologies

- Python
- Jupyter Notebook
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Power BI
- Power Query
- DAX

## Project Workflow

1. Dataset exploration and initial data quality checks using Python.
2. Data preparation and transformation using Power Query.
3. Creation of business KPIs using DAX.
4. Development of interactive Power BI dashboards.
5. Analysis of business performance and preparation of recommendations.

## Dashboard Pages

### 1. Overall Sales & Profit Performance
- Total Sales
- Total Profit
- Total Orders
- Total Units Sold
- Average Order Value
- Profit Margin
- Monthly Sales & Profit Trends

### 2. Category & Product Performance
- Category-wise Sales
- Category-wise Profit
- Category-wise Units Sold
- Top 10 Products by Sales

### 3. Order Status & Revenue Loss
- Delivered Orders
- Shipped Orders
- Returned Orders
- Cancelled Orders
- Return Rate
- Cancellation Rate
- Category-wise Returns & Cancellations

### 4. Payment, Fulfillment & Geographic Performance
- Sales and Profit by Payment Method
- Sales and Profit by Fulfillment Method
- State-wise Sales
- State-wise Profit and Orders

This project uses a supplied Amazon India sales dataset for educational and portfolio purposes. It is not an official Amazon business report.
